figures.finding: There is no rule or permit for a child performer: children may not be employed before fifteen, with no exception for artistic work, so a child under fifteen can't be employed to act, write or direct (reading); a juvenile (fifteen to eighteen) needs a medical check before starting and every six months, may not work at night, on official or religious holidays or rest days, overtime or piece-rate, in remote places or hazardous industries, works at least an hour a day less than adults with breaks so he never works more than four hours in a row, and has three weeks' leave; juveniles working for first-degree relatives under their supervision are exempt.

figures.finding: The Palestine Film Fund (an independent institute's fund, launched May 2025) takes applications for projects by Palestinian directors anywhere; applicants must be eighteen or older when they apply, and for feature or medium-length films must have directed at least one short.

value.feature: at least one short directed before
value.director: Palestinian (a non-Palestinian producer may apply if the director is)

figures.applies: PFF guidelines, cycle open until 4 December (read 2026-11-01).

sources.said: Applications are open to projects by Palestinian directors residing in Palestine or the diaspora - there are no residence requirements beyond nationality/origin. ... Applicants must be 18 years of age or older at the time of application. To apply for feature- or medium-length films, applicants must have previously directed at least one short film .
